metadata.description: Dungar Dev is a deity of Bhil tribe in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat and Maharashtra. There is a temple of Dungar Dev in Jhabua district of Madhya Pradesh where thousands of tribal people visit every day. The tribal people believe that Dungar Dev fulfils the wish of everyone who comes here and offer prayer. The tribals make offering of goat and chicken to their god here.
